**Today's AI Agents News Digest**

AI agent frameworks are reaching a pivotal moment as open-source adoption triples and startups shift from hand-coded orchestration to model-driven agents. Tool-calling reliability has become the key benchmark for frontier models, while multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demos into regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, the industry is rallying around new observability standards to trace agent decisions end to end.
